meta.title: Activities
meta.note: Only activities with an official page read this session are listed. Drive or transit time from each hotel is NOT verified for any activity (no official travel-time source was read), so those cells are blank. Other candidate attractions are listed under Questions as research still needed.
meta.reservationWindow: Feb 15-18, 2027 falls inside Red Rock Canyon's timed-entry season (Oct 1 to May 31).

activities.name: Hoover Dam (guided dam tour, powerplant tour, visitor center)
activities.hours: Hoover Dam open to the public daily 5:00 AM to 9:00 PM (PT). Visitor Center and tours daily 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM; the official page lists exceptions (text truncated in the read; verify on the page).
activities.prices: Guided Dam Tour $40 per person (children 3 and under free); Guided Powerplant Tour $25 adults, $15 ages 4-16; Self-Guided Visitor Center Tour $15 per person. Interagency passes NOT accepted.
activities.specialRules: Special-event activities may be limited around Easter, first two weeks of August, 3 days after Thanksgiving, and the week after Christmas through the first Monday of January (official page).
activities.social: Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/theHooverDam/ (linked from official page). TikTok/Instagram/YouTube for this site: not confirmed.

sources.label: Official Hoover Dam homepage (hours, special events)

activities.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area (Scenic Drive)
activities.category: Nature / scenic drive (a few miles west of Las Vegas, per official page)
activities.hours: Conservation area hours Oct 1 to May 31: November to February 6:00 AM to 5:00 PM (PT); March 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM; April to May 6:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Visitor Center 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM.
activities.specialRules: Timed-entry reservations REQUIRED for vehicle entry to the Scenic Drive Oct 1 to May 31, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, one reservation per day of entry (Recreation.gov, or call (877) 444-6777). Scenic Drive is one-way, 13-mile loop. Parking fills early on weekends and holidays.

activities.name: Valley of Fire State Park
activities.category: Nature / state park (Overton, NV address per official page)
activities.hours: Park open daily, sunrise to sunset. Visitor Center daily 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Office hours Mon-Fri 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
activities.prices: Entrance $10.00 per Nevada vehicle; $15.00 per non-Nevada vehicle (official page).
activities.specialRules: Reservations not required for day use. Trails such as White Domes, Fire Wave, Pinnacles are closed annually May 15 to Sep 30 (official). Park closes to all visitors Dec 1 to Dec 14 each year (not in the Feb 2027 window). Official page warns that Uber/Lyft can strand visitors because return rides are often unavailable.

activities.name: The Neon Museum (Neon Boneyard and North Gallery)
activities.hours: Sept to May: 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM daily (last entry 10:00 PM). June to August: 8:00 PM to midnight (last entry 11:00 PM). Official weekly grid shows 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM for every day of the week shown on the page read.
activities.prices: Not read (ticket page is dynamic). Official FAQ: from January 1, 2027, arriving earlier or later than the selected ticket time may cost more.
activities.specialRules: Outdoor site: tours cancel if the temperature is above 100 F; General Admission closes above 105 F; Museum closes above 110 F. Rain or shine. Phone 702-387-6366.
activities.social: TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@neonmuseumlasvegas ; Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theneonmuseumlasvegas/ (both linked on the official site)
